spans.s: --a R. flows through the Uttarakuru country and falls into the north ocean. वा. ४२. ७६-7.
--a यादव; a son of साम्बा. वा. ९६. २५२.
--barks of trees to cover nakedness; applied to harassed subjects living in the mountain valleys in degenerate times. Vi. IV. २४. ९६.
(I)--came to see the Trivikrama form of Hari. भा. VIII. २१. 2.
--a son of वासना and Arka; a Vasu. भा.
(II)--a God of the Harita गण. Br.

(I)--the wife of बृहस्पति, and abducted by Soma. Of this union was born Budha. Through ब्रह्मा's influ- ence she was restored to her husband; (came back to बृहस्- pati after a battle between the Devas and the दानवस्). भा. IX. १
(III)--a daughter of सुषेण and queen of वालि; her son was अङ्गद. Br.
(IV)--also तोरणेश्वरि and ताराम्बिका; a शक्ति living in the midst of waters that could be crossed only by boats of different sizes. Br. IV. ३५. १२-24, ५८; ३६. १६; ४४. ८०.
(VI)--one of the ten branches of the Harita group of Devas. वा. १००. ८९.

Lust after more territory.

(III)--from तारण or that which takes good men across to next world. M. १२८. ३४ and ५६. [page२-019+ ३३]

(IV)--a son of वज्रान्ग and वरान्गी who troubled the Devas and destined to be killed by a baby of seven days; relieved his mother (तारक) from sorrows and hence the name; एत्य्। was crowned king of the Asura world; did penance at the पारियात्र cave when ब्रह्मा granted his wish to be killed by a lad of seven days. All लोकपालस् served him. He wanted to vanquish Hari and set out with Grasana as commander. The flag of मकर was hoisted. Indra's report to बृहस्पति.
1: M. Chh. १४६-149; १६०. २५-6; Br. IV. ११. 7.
The war in which he was killed by कुमार.
2: Br. III. १०. ४९; IV. ३०. १०३; वा. ७२. ४७.
--सुनीती, the mother of Dhruva, known as. Vi. I. १२. ९४.
--extent of, west to east five thousand yojanas; above it are the slow moving Saura, Angira and Vakra; under it are the Sun, Moon, Budha and भार्गव which revolve swiftly. वा. ५३. ७०-4.
--by worship of Mukti and वामन, the two boats to cross the ocean of सम्सार. वा. १०८. ३७.

(I)--A देवासुर battle in कृत yuga; तारा's (तारका, बृहस्पति's wife) abduction by Soma, was the ground for war between the Asuras and the Suras. शुक्र joined Soma while शिव and Indra took up बृहस्- pati's cause.
1: भा. IX. १

. ८८; ६५. ३४; ७२. २०-21, ७४; M. Chh. १७३- १७८.
the fifth battle in which Virocana was blessed with eternal life by शिव;
3: वा. ९७. २१, ७४ and ८०.

(II)--the fifth of the twelve कोलाहलस्. Indra killed Virocana, son of प्रह्लाद. M. ४७. ४३-9.
--above नक्षत्रमण्डल; below this Budha moves. वा. १०१. ३१, १३२.
--the high and low strains of a song; sung by कृष्ण. Vi. V. १३. १६, ५६.
--Lord of the stars; the moon. वा. ४१. ५८.
--a son of चन्द्रावलोक of the सूर्यवम्श. M. १२. ५४.
--(तार्क्ष्य-वा। प्। and वि। प्।): सेनानि with the Sun in Hemanta. Br. II. २३. १८; वा. ५२. १८.

. २४; १७. २२.
